research_question: Can a new evidence-sufficiency representation reduce no-evidence false retrieval while preserving answerable retrieval quality, without retuning frozen candidate-v2?

prohibited_for_design_selection: abstention validation results before candidate-v3 freeze

mechanism_hypotheses.mechanism: Represent the requested relation/attribute as a predicate-slot signature and require retrieved evidence to explicitly support that slot rather than merely overlap the entity/topic.
mechanism_hypotheses.risk: May miss synonym/paraphrase support if the relation ontology is too narrow.

mechanism_hypotheses.mechanism: Represent assertion modality and unresolved conflict; abstain when a query requires confirmed/current evidence but all candidate evidence is explicitly uncertain or mutually unresolved.
mechanism_hypotheses.risk: Does not by itself solve wrong-field or lexical-decoy cases.

mechanism_hypotheses.mechanism: Combine predicate-slot support, asserted-value presence, certainty/conflict checks, and question-echo rejection as a separate evidence-sufficiency layer while preserving frozen candidate-v2 ranking order among supported memories.
mechanism_hypotheses.new_information: structured support signature independent of candidate-v2 ranking score/margin/coverage
mechanism_hypotheses.risk: Rule-based relation aliases may not generalize to unseen predicates; confirmatory v5 must include unseen relations and paraphrases.

selected_architecture.selection_basis: Development failure taxonomy coverage only. H1 does not resolve uncertainty/conflict; H2 does not resolve wrong-field/lexical-decoy failures; H3 is the only preregistered mechanism that addresses both families without using candidate-v2 score thresholds.
selected_architecture.ranking_mechanism: Call frozen pse_candidate_v2_rank and preserve its relative order only for memories that pass the new evidence-sufficiency signature.
selected_architecture.abstention_mechanism: Return an empty ranking when no retrieved memory provides relation-slot support plus an asserted value under required certainty, or when the top evidence is a question echo.

validation_phase.on_failure: Reject candidate-v3; any modified mechanism requires candidate-v4 identity.

staged_execution.stage_1: Run local PSE and cheap baselines and verify benchmark discrimination before spending A-MEM compute.
staged_execution.stage_2: Run exact-pinned A-MEM only if preregistered discrimination checks pass.

confirmatory_retrieval_guardrail.interpretation: Candidate-v3 MRR may not trail frozen candidate-v2 by more than 0.03 absolute on v5.

required_integrity: candidate-v3 frozen before validation and v5
v5 frozen before any v5 result
gate_e_selection_rule.independent_reproduction: If the authoritative Gate E definition requires independent reproduction, candidate-selection evidence may complete but Gate E must remain NOT_COMPLETE until that requirement is satisfied.

claim_boundary: Development and future non-sealed confirmatory research only. This preregistration does not establish Gate E completion, parity, superiority, equivalence, non-inferiority, SOTA, sealed-final readiness, or production readiness.
